description: Status of a 360 capture started with pano_capture_start. Returns status (queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled), stage (download, stitch, frames, sfm, train, export or upload) and progress from 0 to 1 while it runs. When it has succeeded it returns result URLs you own: ply_url (standard Gaussian splat PLY), spz_url (compressed splat), preview_url (flythrough video), poster_url and viewer_url (opens the scene in the three.ws viewer). When it failed it returns a readable reason. It never starts or repeats work, so call it as often as needed, about once a minute. Use this when a capture job_id needs its current state or finished files.

job_id.description: The job_id the start tool returned.

name: pano_capture_status
